label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Dear Mr Ogunleye,

Thank you for picking up my black Jansport bag and calling the number on my lab manual. I am grateful that you kept it safe and made the effort to contact me. Not everyone would have done that.

I forgot the bag in the danfo travelling from Oshodi to Igando on Friday evening, 6 November, when I came down at Ikotun. It contains my lab manual, dissecting kit, student ID card, two textbooks, calculator and glasses.

Sir, I am appealing to you to please return it. I am a first-year Biology student, and my BIO 101 practical is on Wednesday, 11 November, at 10 a.m. Without my dissecting kit, I will not be allowed into the practical. My ID card, glasses and study materials are also things I need for school every day.

I can offer ₦10,000 towards your transport and as a thank-you for keeping the bag safe. That is all my allowance, and it is the most I can manage. I cannot afford ₦40,000, and I do not want to promise money I cannot provide.

You spoke kindly during our first call, so I was worried when you later said I should pay ₦40,000 or forget the bag. I appreciate your help, but I am asking that you please reconsider that condition so we can arrange a reasonable handover.

Please choose a daytime meeting before Wednesday. My roommate, Adaeze, will accompany me. We could meet at Ikotun roundabout or, if convenient for you, by the Ikotun Police Division gate, simply as a public meeting point. I can give you the ₦10,000 when we meet and you hand over the bag.

Please reply to confirm whether you will accept this and let me know a suitable time and place.

Thank you for your understanding.

Yours sincerely,  
[Your name]
